svg.aria-label: For 469 moments when a Python project pinned or locked a widely used library, what the container recipe the project kept at that moment would install: from the pinned file, not from it, undecided, none of the project's requirements, or no recipe, for all pairs and by kind of pin
svg.text: What a pinned project's own container recipe would install
469 moments, from 2025 to 2026, when one of 332 Python projects held an older version of a library in a pin or lockfile
as a new release came out; the recipe read at the project's last commit before the release
